Game Overview

In The Metro Anomaly, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a haunting labyrinth in an abandoned subway where reality twists at every turn. Embrace the silence and eerie presence as you rely on intuition to escape looping circles. A single misstep could reset your journey. Will you conquer the anomaly or start over in this mind-bending horror?
